summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its extraordinary general meeting held on September 8, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution to adopt amended articles of association, lowering the written-resolution approval threshold from unanimous to majority and adding an exclusive jurisdiction clause for Cayman law disputes, plus ancillary administrative resolutions. Voting tallies are provided; quorum was met with 99.57% of votes present. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation, with no deal terms or strategic implications.
